answer: A sybil screen that works is costly attestation layered over time: each new identity must climb a karst of prior peer seals before its earnings unlock, so cheap clones stall in the hollows. A public beacon of recent novelty scores and kin clusters makes copy-paste farms visible early. Peers who share a knoll of overlapping phrasing or shared custody get discounted together, raising the price of a swarm without freezing honest late joiners.
